MeterChangeDetector.java.notes: Whole-note-denominator OCR filter retains its two-written-bar guard. Joined system-header ink can hide non-four stacked signatures from the initial projection scan; a bounded symbol-pair recovery now presents them to OCR only after nearby clef/key evidence and before the first notehead. Synthetic positive/head-veto controls; private 121-page candidate audit added 126 crops, retained all 1963 older crops, and recovered printed 6/4 headers on PDFs 6, 106, 116. Standalone explicit annotations remain authoritative, and Android OCR recognition of the recovered crops is not device-verified. Uses Collectors.toList for Android API 26 compatibility. Reviewed inline 12/8 recovery: permits a lower numeral mislabeled as a notehead only after a complete preceding barline and an upper numeral. Original synthetic joined-meter control; private four-page trial recovered both printed changes, with Android OCR reading both crops.

OmrMeasurePostProcessor.java.notes: App and standalone source and synthetic regression were reviewed for full text parity apart from the package name. Raw barline validation rejects oscillating arpeggios and preserves straight thick and faint bars. A narrow symbol-only opening key/meter pocket does not create a measure. A symbolic harmonic head with nearby stem evidence vetoes a false full-height barline, while an isolated printed bar and a symbol-only header stroke remain boundaries. Private 121-page replay and source crops remain outside this repository. No model or dependency changes. A one-pixel semantic staff-row bias can make the local printed-rule offset alias to the neighboring line; only an isolated full-height raw rule gets a one-row retry. Synthetic offset regression and private matched-input 121-page replay confirm one recovered printed bar and no extra bars; private source fixtures remain excluded. A verified printed five-rule fringe no longer connects a nearby notehead to an isolated full-height bar; an attached head near the column or a connection through a true staff space still vetoes a note stem. Synthetic old-failing regression and private 121-page matched-input replay recovered two source-checked bars with unchanged note count and pitches. Two printed quarter notes on one affected page also recovered their durations. Private source crops remain excluded.

OmrScoreInterpreter.java.notes: Scoped finiteBeamOverRule repair tolerates a bounded articulation followed by a fresh uninterrupted thin witness, not a long thick tail. Raw hollow-core guard for a side-by-side unison rejects a bright notch over a filled head. Original synthetic tests. A small spurious head inside two matching printed meter numerals is removed only in a first-system measure, preserving an independently stemmed note; source-reviewed PDF55 and PDF104 changes and all 121-page replay stayed private. A parallel-beam mask island can be nearly as large as its owning head; paired raw beam continuity and a complete attached main stem still guard rejection. Original synthetic ownership and rounded-head controls; private 121-page Flesch replay found 141 source-reviewed beam-only removals on 64 pages. Short paired merged beams can also contain a false mask island; a separate synthetic regression guards stem ownership, paired raw cores, single beams, and protruding real heads. A private 121-page replay found 69 additional source-reviewed beam-only removals across 54 pages, with timing effects confined to those measures and stable measure geometry. Detached fingering numerals beneath independently stemmed notes are rejected only when small, stemless, aligned and below staff; synthetic controls preserve a stemmed low note, missing owner and offset note. A matched-input 121-page private replay removed exactly two source-reviewed finger numerals on PDFs70 and100, with six onsets and two durations changed only in affected measures, no added events or measure geometry changes. A natural touching the following note can have its semantic box extended by that note stem. A narrower raw crop only at the touching edge retains the natural spines and excludes the foreign stem; original synthetic natural and flat controls plus existing boundary regressions pass. Private matched-input 121-page replay changed 104 pitches across 38 pages, with no note-count, timing, tie, or measure-geometry changes; source contact sheets reviewed the printed accidental passages. Interrupted staff rules can remain in a natural crop at both spine endpoints and make the genuine natural appear symmetric. A second shape check removes only long horizontal rows from a copied crop; original natural and flat synthetic controls preserve the endpoint and false-positive boundary. Matched-input private 121-page production replay changed 73 source-reviewed pitches across 41 pages, including both affected chapter openings, with unchanged note counts, onsets, durations, ties and measure geometry. A wide printed double sharp may share its semantic box with a nearby stem and staff rules; paired raw white notches around a dark waist recover it. Original synthetic paired-notch, one-notch, and natural controls; private matched-input 121-page replay changed 53 pitches on PDFs80-84 with unchanged note counts, timing, ties and measure geometry. Contact sheets were reviewed; a pre-existing false beam note on PDF83 remains open. No weights or dependencies changed. A tiny stemless semantic island on one core of a paired beam can appear near its endpoint; probing the offset seam with existing straight-core evidence rejects it without suppressing a full head, a single beam or an independently stemmed note. Original synthetic controls, private matched-input 121-page replay, and private source crops show eight removed beam-only events on seven pages. No pitches, ties, or measure geometry changed; 72 onsets and nine durations changed only within affected measures. PDF83 opening returns two voices of sixteen sixteenth notes. Exact timing on other passages remains under audit. A bounded 1.2-gap tall island and half-gap offset seam probe remove 66 additional source-reviewed beam-only events across 43 pages in a matched-input private 121-page replay; no pitch or measure geometry changed, with one exposed tie classification still under audit. Original synthetic owner, no-owner and tall-island controls. A round mark below the next rising head is its staccato, not an augmentation dot to the prior head. Original synthetic aligned, absent-owner, ordinary-dot, and same-height controls; private matched-input 121-page replay changed 136 durations and 448 onsets across 29 pages, with no event, pitch, tie, or measure-geometry changes. Source crops for all affected durations were reviewed; PDF89m25 now has 16 consecutive sixteenths. A printed pitch-changing accidental cannot complete a tie to a previous different sounding pitch; keep key-signature and missing-key controls and preserve carried-accidental cases. Original synthetic slur, courtesy-sharp, absent-key and carried-accidental tests; private matched-input 121-page replay clears 1605 previously marked ties across 108 pages with no event, pitch, timing, or measure-geometry changes. Thirty private source crops sampled across chapters show accidental notes and slurs; the full independent source-note audit remains open. No model or dependency change. Prior stemBeforePaperTail repair retained. Unrelated pre-existing app decoder drift remains visible; source_sha256 intentionally unchanged, not whole-file parity. Scoped shortPairedMergedBeamHeads bound refinement: accept head-sized mask islands only when two larger independently stemmed heads own a short paired beam; source-reviewed private 121-page replay removed 24 beam-only events across 17 pages. Original synthetic large-island, one-owner, thin-beam and protruding-oval controls; one adjacent island on PDF69 remains under audit. Existing unrelated app decoder drift remains visible; source_sha256 intentionally unchanged. Scoped Evil Twin violin repairs reviewed and ported: remove isolated beam-tip, grace-flag and inline denominator false heads; suppress joined grace-tail false accidental; classify offset natural/sharp spines and a flat bowl beneath an upper beamed stem. Original synthetic regressions and private four-page source-glyph comparison. Existing unrelated app decoder drift remains visible; source_sha256 intentionally unchanged. Scoped working-tree repair reviewed on app commit 75c25e4349e7a27e5303dd0645c53dec58eb3353: side-by-side unison accepts a hollow head crossed by a dark staff rule only when separate bright upper and lower pockets remain; a filled head with an upper notch stays rejected. Original synthetic pixels and private score regression were reviewed; no private fixture or model change was published. Other app decoder drift remains visible, so the whole-file source_sha256 is intentionally unchanged. A second source-reviewed raster exposed a smaller lower hollow pocket (4 of 35 samples); the lower-pocket threshold is now 10 percent while the upper-pocket and dark-rule guards remain. Generated narrow-pocket and filled-notch controls passed; source image remains private.

beam_and_header_review.boundary: Original raw-ink evidence preserves separate beam groups beneath fingering numerals while honoring explicit brackets. broken_flat_shaft_review.boundary: Source-ink recovery requires an existing flat family, a substantial vertical shaft and a verified lower-right bowl. Small scan gaps may connect shaft pieces; isolated staff-rule pixels cannot start a recovered shaft. Original semantic spine count remains a lower bound. Synthetic broken-shaft and absent-bowl regressions preserve prior SplitFlatSpineTest coverage. Only this shared OmrScoreInterpreter change was ported; prior unrelated drift remains visible. No model or private fixture changes.

signature_boundary_spacing_review.boundary: Require adjacent vertical strokes for a double bar, excluding distant accidental shafts. A lone key symbol without a clef must follow its boundary locally; distant clef fragments cannot become key changes. The three pre-existing unrelated mapped drifts remain visible.

imported_tab_layout_review.boundary: Shared six-rule geometry now checks multiple grayscale thresholds, wider string spacing, pale vertical barlines, and excludes partial tab rows from standard-staff pairing. Dark notation retains strict rule-length agreement; pale interrupted rules additionally require enclosing bars. Nine original synthetic tests cover faint, dashed, enlarged and negative standard-notation cases. No weights, OCR engine or tuning changes; no private fixtures included. Geometry validation is not full fret or timing accuracy.

damaged_study_notation_review.boundary: Global printed-ink recovery for fragmented clefs and key symbols, partial repeated sharp signatures, ledger-attached octave numerals, fingerings opposite a longer continuous beam, and tuplets assigned across system boundaries. Single-beam mask islands are rejected only with a larger stem-owning note and a straight beam without a rounded head bulge. Original synthetic regressions cover damaged and genuine key changes, adjacent systems, brackets, octave direction, staff-rule intersections and small chord heads. No model weights, private scores, manual meter annotations, device logs or external code included. Prior unrelated OmrScoreInterpreter drift remains visible; only reviewed hunks were ported. Guide cache invalidation is Android-only. These checks do not constitute complete source-note verification.

isolated_beam_probe_review.boundary: Resolve a conflicting extra beam only when two noteheads share a physical stem and endpoint, the longer trace reads one fewer beam, and adjacent pixel probes corroborate that lower count. Single-note readings and consistent chord beams retain their existing behavior. Six original generated regressions cover scan-fringe cores, a shared chord stem, a narrow supported beam and conservative single-note handling. Existing unrelated OmrScoreInterpreter drift remains reported. No model or private fixtures included.

isolated_tab_fret_review.boundary: Shared raster crops isolate printed frets from rules, barlines, labels, rhythm stems and dense screenshot controls. Cleaned and original OCR readings are reconciled within each crop; a long central enclosed counter corroborates open frets. Confirmed inline effects are retained. Dark and pale barline passes are combined, and unbarred opening/closing tab measures retain their notes. Android ML Kit remains an app adapter: it reads bounded glyph montages with synthetic numeric context, maps symbols back to original crops, and preserves partial results on timeouts. Standalone OCR providers may use TabFretRaster.crops, clean, openFret and reconcile before TablatureDecoder.withWords. The standalone package does not bundle an OCR engine. Synthetic tests only; no private scores, fret transcriptions, phone logs, or fonts are included. Model weights unchanged; printed fret correctness does not establish unwritten rhythm or graphical bend/slur performance.
